_source: Sublime Text command metadata from CommandsBrowser (https://github.com/Sublime-Instincts/CommandsBrowser, directory st_commands_metadata/), MIT License, Copyright 2021 Ashwin Shenoy. Used to generate typed tools; see tools/generate_st_command_tools.py.
_refresh: Re-copy the merged st_commands_metadata/*.json into 'commands' and run: python tools/generate_st_command_tools.py

add_directory.doc_string: Opens an OS dialog box to prompt for a folder to the 'Where' field in the 'Find in Files' panel.

add_jump_record.doc_string: Allows packages/plugins to add a jump point without changing the selection.

args.name: selection
args.doc_string: The selection to be added to the jump history. Can be an integer, a list of 2 integers or a list of list of 2 integers.

add_where_snippet.doc_string: Adds a snippet to the 'Where' field in the 'Find in Files' panel.

args.name: snippet
args.doc_string: The string to be inserted into the 'Where' field in the 'Find in Files' panel. Supports snippet like variables.

add_word.doc_string: Adds the given word to the 'added_words' setting in the user preferences.

args.name: word
args.doc_string: The word to be added.

append.doc_string: Appends the given text string to the end of the buffer.

args.name: characters
args.doc_string: The string to be appended to the end of the text buffer.

args.name: scroll_to_end
args.doc_string: Whether to scroll to the end of the buffer after appending.

args.name: disable_tab_translation
args.doc_string: Whether to disable translating tabs to spaces.

arithmetic.doc_string: Evaluates the given expression. If the expression is not provided, it launches a TextInputHandler to gather the expression from the user.

args.name: expr
args.doc_string: The expression to evaluate.

args.name: api_completions_only
args.doc_string: Whether to include completions from snippets/completions file in the AC panel.

auto_complete_open_link.doc_string: Opens the first link in the details pane of the AC panel, when the AC panel is visible.

auto_complete_prev.doc_string: Goes to the previous entry in the AC panel, when the AC panel is visible.

build.doc_string: Executes the provided build system or prompt for selection (select: true) and choose a default. build_system should be a resource path to a build system file or the name of a project-specific build system

args.name: select
args.doc_string: Whether to prompt for selecting a build system.

args.name: build_system
args.doc_string: A resource path to a .sublime-build file.

args.name: variant
args.doc_string: The name of the variant present in the build system as specified by the 'name' key.

cancel_find.doc_string: Cancels the Find panel, closing it.

chain.doc_string: Runs a given set of command(s) sequentially, along with their argument(s) if any.

args.name: commands
args.doc_string: The list of commands and their respective arguments.

clear_bookmarks.doc_string: Remove(s) all bookmark(s) in the current document.

clear_fields.doc_string: Clears the fields of the currently active snippet.

clear_location.doc_string: Clears the 'Where' field in the Find in Files panel.

clear_missing_recent_projects_and_worksp.doc_string: Clears any deleted projects or workspaces from the session.

clear_recent_files.doc_string: Clears the list of recently opened files.

clear_recent_projects_and_workspaces.doc_string: Clears the list of recently opened projects and workspaces.

clone_file.doc_string: Creates a new view into the file.

args.name: add_to_selection
args.doc_string: Whether to add the opened cloned file as a part of the current group's multiselected sheet(s).

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The group number to open the cloned file to.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the group to open the cloned file to.

close_by_index.doc_string: Closes a view of the given group by it's index.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_deleted_files.doc_string: Closes all views into deleted files.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

close_folder_list.doc_string: Removes all the folder(s) from the sidebar and hides it.

close_others_by_index.doc_string: Closes all views of a group but the one identified by group and index.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_pane.doc_string: Closes a group, given by its index. A value of -1 indicates the active group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

close_selected.doc_string: Closes all selected views in a group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_to_right_by_index.doc_string: Closes all views of a group right of the one identified by index.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_transient.doc_string: Closes all transient sheets and views.

close_unmodified.doc_string: Closes all unmodified views of a group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_unmodified_to_right_by_index.doc_string: Closes all unmodified views of a group right of the one identified by index.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

close_unselected.doc_string: Closes all unselected views in a group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index within the target group.

commit_completion.doc_string: Inserts the selected completion into the text and closes the AC panel.

console_python_version.doc_string: Switches the python interpreter version in console input.

args.name: version
args.doc_string: The version of the python interpreter. Valid values are '3.3' or '3.8'.

context_menu.doc_string: Shows the context menu for the current view.

convert_color_scheme.doc_string: Converts a color scheme from the older '.tmTheme' format to the newer '.sublime-color-scheme' format provided the active view is a '.tmTheme' file.

args.name: use_variables
args.doc_string: Indicates how the color values in the '.tmTheme' file has to be transformed. Valid values are 'hsl', 'yes', 'no'.

convert_ident_case.doc_string: Transforms the target selection(s) based on the specified casing.

args.name: case
args.doc_string: The target casing. Valid values are 'upper', 'lower' & 'title'.

args.name: first_case
args.doc_string: The casing of the first word. Defaults to the value of the argument 'case', if not specified.

args.name: separator
args.doc_string: The string to use to seperate words.

convert_syntax.doc_string: Converts a syntax file from the older .tmLanguage format to the newer .sublime-syntax format, provided the active view is a .tmLanguage file.

copy.doc_string: Copies the given selection(s) to the system clipboard.

copy_as_html.doc_string: Copies the contents of the current view as rich HTML to the system clipboard.

copy_path.doc_string: Copies the active view's file name to the clipboard, if the active view represents a file on disk.

correct_spelling.doc_string: Corrects the incorrectly spelled word based on the incorrect word's region and the correction.

args.name: begin
args.doc_string: The integer that represents the beginning of the region that spans the incorrect word.

args.name: end
args.doc_string: The integer that represents the end of the region that spans the incorrect word.

args.name: correction
args.doc_string: The string to be placed as a correction for the incorrect word.

customize_color_scheme.doc_string: Opens a new side by side window layout, with the current color scheme (default version) on the left & the user version on the right side. To make color scheme customization easier.

customize_theme.doc_string: Opens a new side by side window layout, with the current theme (default version) on the left & the user version on the right side. To make theme customization easier.

cut.doc_string: Cut(s) the given selection(s) to the system clipboard.

delete_file.doc_string: Deletes the given file(s) by moving the file(s) to the system trash/recycle bin.

args.name: files
args.doc_string: The absolute path(s) to the given file(s) on disk.

args.name: prompt
args.doc_string: Whether to prompt the user to confirm the deletion by showing a dialog box.

delete_folder.doc_string: Deletes the given folder(s) by moving the folder(s) to the system trash bin.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: The absolute path(s) to the given folder(s) on disk.

args.name: prompt
args.doc_string: Whether to prompt the user to confirm the deletion by showing a dialog box.

delete_word.doc_string: Deletes the (sub-)word in front of or after each caret.

args.name: forward
args.doc_string: Whether the forward (sub-)word should be deleted.

args.name: sub_words
args.doc_string: Whether to delete subwords.

detect_indentation.doc_string: Guess the indentation settings for the active view from the text content.

args.name: show_message
args.doc_string: Whether to show a message in the status bar about the guessed indentation settings.

args.name: by
args.doc_string: The mode of selection. Valid values are 'words', 'columns' and 'lines'.

args.name: event
args.doc_string: An object that consists of the x & y window coordinates & the button detail via the button key.

args.name: additive
args.doc_string: Whether to add the selection to the existing selection(s).

args.name: subtractive
args.doc_string: Whether to remove the existing selection(s) before adding the new selection.

duplicate_line.doc_string: Create a copy of each caret's line.

echo.doc_string: Prints any given arbitrary argument(s) to the console output.

edit_settings.doc_string: Opens the default settings file and its user version in a split layout window.

args.name: base_file
args.doc_string: A unicode string of the path to the base settings file. Typically this will be in the form: '${packages}/PackageName/Package.sublime-settings'

args.name: user_file
args.doc_string: An optional file path to the users editable version of the settings file. If not provided, the filename from 'base_file' argument will be appended to '${packages}/User/'

args.name: default
args.doc_string: An optional unicode string of the default contents if the user version of the settings file does not yet exist. Use '$0' to place the cursor.

edit_syntax_settings.doc_string: Opens the syntax-specific settings file for the currently active view in a split window layout. The left handow window contains the default syntax specific settings & the right handow contains the user syntax specific settings.

exec.doc_string: Runs an external process asynchronously. This is the default target option for any build system.

args.name: cmd
args.doc_string: The executable to run, plus any arguments to pass to it. Shell constructs such as piping and redirection are not supported.

args.name: shell_cmd
args.doc_string: A shell command to execute. Unlike the 'cmd' option, this does allow piping and redirection. Will use bash on Mac and Linux machine and cmd.exe on Windows.

args.name: file_regex
args.doc_string: A regular expression to run on the build output to match file information. The matched file information is used to enable result navigation

args.name: line_regex
args.doc_string: A regular expression to run on the build output to match line information. The matched file information is used to enable result navigation

args.name: working_dir
args.doc_string: The absolute path to the directory where the build process has to be launched. The default value is an empty string, which means that the process will be launched in the active view's directory.

args.name: encoding
args.doc_string: The encoding of the build system output. Defaults to 'utf-8'.

args.name: env
args.doc_string: Any environment variables to be made available when the build launches.

args.name: quiet
args.doc_string: Reduces the amount of output about the build system invocation.

args.name: kill
args.doc_string: Whether to kill the running process. The default value is 'False'.

args.name: kill_previous
args.doc_string: Whether to kill the previously running process before starting a new build.

args.name: word_wrap
args.doc_string: Whether to apply word wrap on the build output. The default value is 'True'

args.name: syntax
args.doc_string: The 'Packages/' relative path to a syntax file to be applied on the build output. The default value is 'Packages/Text/Plain text.tmLanguage'.

exit.doc_string: Closes all windows and exists the application.

expand_selection.doc_string: Expands the current text caret selection(s) to the specified location.

args.name: to
args.doc_string: The entity to expand the caret selection(s) to. Valid values can be 'line', 'scope', 'brackets', 'indentation', 'tag', 'bol', 'hardbol', 'eol', 'hardeol', 'bof', 'eof', 'brackets' and 'smart'.

expand_selection_to_paragraph.doc_string: Expands the current text caret selection(s) to the paragraph(s).

expand_snippet.doc_string: Expands the snippet under the cursor.

find_all.doc_string: Finds all the tokens which match the find pattern.

args.name: close_panel
args.doc_string: Whether to close the Find panel after executing the Find All option. This argument holds good only for the Find & Replace panel.

find_all_under.doc_string: Searches and selects all text matches, which are the same as the selected text or the word under the caret.

find_in_folder.doc_string: Populates the 'Where' field of 'Find in Files' panel with the given directorie(s).

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: The list of absolute paths to the folders which should be searched.

find_next.doc_string: Jumps to the next occurrence of the text or pattern in the find buffer.

find_prev.doc_string: Jumps to the previous occurrence of the text or pattern in the find buffer.

find_under.doc_string: Finds the next occurrence of the current selection or the current word.

find_under_expand.doc_string: Adds a new selection based on the current selection or expands the selection to the current word.

find_under_expand_skip.doc_string: Adds a new selection based on the current selection or expands the selection to the current word while removing the current selection.

find_under_prev.doc_string: Finds the previous occurrence of the current selection or the current word.

focus_by_index.doc_string: Focus one of multiple selected views in the active group by its index.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index number of the view to be focussed.

focus_group.doc_string: Set the focus to a view in an other group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the group that has to be focused.

focus_neighboring_group.doc_string: Focus the neighboring group of the currently focused group.

args.name: forward
args.doc_string: Whether the neighboring group should be the next group.

focus_side_bar.doc_string: Focus the sidebar to enable navigation by keyboard.

focus_to_left.doc_string: Changes the focus to the left sheet (if any) of the current sheet in multi selected sheet(s).

focus_to_right.doc_string: Changes the focus to the right sheet (if any) of the current sheet in multi selected sheet(s).

fold_by_level.doc_string: Folds all the code at a given indentation level.

args.name: level
args.doc_string: The indentation level of the code.

args.name: symbol
args.doc_string: The symbol information.

goto_line.doc_string: Navigates to the specified line, additionally scrolling the viewport such that the given line is in the middle of the visible viewport.

args.name: line
args.doc_string: The line number to navigate to.

goto_symbol_in_project.doc_string: Open the Goto Symbol In Project quick panel.

hide_auto_complete.doc_string: Hides the AC popup, if visible.

hide_popup.doc_string: Hides the popup window, if visible.

hot_exit.doc_string: Saves the session and exits the application even if the 'hot_exit' setting is disabled in preferences.

html_print.doc_string: Saves the current view as a temporary HTML file and sends it to the default browser for printing.

ignore_word.doc_string: Adds the given word to the ignored_words setting.

args.name: word
args.doc_string: The word to be ignored.

indent.doc_string: Increase the indentation level of the text selection(s).

insert.doc_string: Insert the specified text into the document at the text caret location(s).

args.name: characters
args.doc_string: The string to be inserted.

insert_snippet.doc_string: Insert the specified snippet content into the document at the text caret location(s).

args.name: contents
args.doc_string: The snippet as a string to be inserted. Accepts snippet like variables, including built in ones. The backslashes have to be escaped like in case of every JSON string.

args.name: name
args.doc_string: Relative path to a .sublime-snippet file, the contents of which will be inserted.

install_package_control.doc_string: Installs Package Control in a freshly installed application.

invert_selection.doc_string: Inverts the given selection(s) i.e the non selected region(s) are selected & the selected region(s) are removed from the selection.

join_lines.doc_string: Joins the current line with the following line.

jump_back.doc_string: Jumps back to the previous location in the jump history list.

jump_forward.doc_string: Jumps forward to the next location in the jump history list.

left_delete.doc_string: Deletes the character(s) to the left of the text selection caret(s).

lower_case.doc_string: Converts the word under the cursor(s) to lower case.

move.doc_string: Moves the selection caret(s) by the specified unit.

args.name: by
args.doc_string: The unit name. Valid values are 'chars', 'pages', 'lines', 'characters', 'words', 'word_ends', 'subwords', 'subword_ends' and 'stops'.

args.name: forward
args.doc_string: Whether to move in the forward direction.

args.name: extend
args.doc_string: Whether to extend the selection as the caret(s) move.

args.name: ignore_auto_complete
args.doc_string: Whether to skip navigating the AC items when the AC is open.

move_to.doc_string: Moves the selection caret(s) to the specified relative location.

args.name: to
args.doc_string: The relative location. Valid values are 'eol', 'bol', 'eof', 'bof' and 'brackets'.

args.name: extend
args.doc_string: Whether to extend the selection while moving to the specified relative location.

move_to_group.doc_string: Moves the active tab to the specified layout group.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The index of the target group.

move_to_neighboring_group.doc_string: Moves the active tab to the neighboring group.

args.name: forward
args.doc_string: Whether to move the tab in the forward direction.

new_build_system.doc_string: Creates a new view and populates it with a simple build system boilerplate.

new_file.doc_string: Create a new empty tab in the active window.

args.name: syntax
args.doc_string: The syntax to be set for the newly opened tab. Should be a package relative path like 'Packages/Foo/Bar.sublime-syntax'. Currently, 'scope:' prefixed syntax names won't work.

new_file_at.doc_string: Creates a new empty tab in the active window.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: A list of absolute directory paths were the new tab has to be saved. Only the first value is considered.

new_folder.doc_string: Creates a new folder in the given directory.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: A list of absolute directory paths. Only the first is considered for creating the new folder.

new_os_tab.doc_string: Creates a new empty window in the os tab.

new_plugin.doc_string: Creates a new view and populates it with a simple plugin boilerplate.

new_snippet.doc_string: Creates a new view and populates it with a simple snippet boilerplate.

new_syntax.doc_string: Creates a new view and populates it with a simple syntax boilerplate.

new_window_for_project.doc_string: Clones the project into a new workspace.

next_bookmark.doc_string: Navigate to the next bookmark in the document.

next_field.doc_string: Navigate to the next field in the snippet.

next_misspelling.doc_string: Navigate to the next misspelling in the document.

next_modification.doc_string: Navigate to the next modification in the document.

next_os_tab.doc_string: Set the focus to the next window in the os tab.

next_result.doc_string: Jump to the next build result.

next_view.doc_string: Sets the focus to the next view by index.

args.name: extend
args.doc_string: Whether to add the next view to the current group's multi selected tabs.

next_view_in_stack.doc_string: Set the focus to the next view in the stack of recent edited view.

noop.doc_string: A non existent command. Use this if you want to unbind any particular key binding & release it to the OS (ST 4117+).

open_containing_folder.doc_string: Opens the folder containing the given file in the default OS file manager.

args.name: files
args.doc_string: The list of absolute file paths. Only the first value is considered.

open_context_url.doc_string: Opens the url under the mouse click in the default browser.

open_dir.doc_string: Opens the specified dir in the default file manager application, optionally highlighting the specified file.

args.name: dir
args.doc_string: The absolute path to the directory to be opened in the default file manager application.

args.name: file
args.doc_string: The name of the file that is to be highlighted when the file manager application is launched, relative to the path of the directory.

open_file.doc_string: Opens the specified file. Will dynamically open resource files from '.sublime-package' archives as read-only, if the specified override file does not exist.

args.name: file
args.doc_string: Absolute path to the file to be opened. Also accepts snippet like variables like '$packages' which will be expanded.

args.name: contents
args.doc_string: The contents to be put in the file, if the file doesn't exist.

args.name: group
args.doc_string: The group to open the file into. The group needs to exist for this argument to work.

args.name: add_to_selection
args.doc_string: Whether to add the opened file as a part of the current group's multiselected sheet(s).

args.name: encoded_position
args.doc_string: Whether to open the file at the given line & column. The line & column information must be specified in the 'file' argument.

open_file_settings.doc_string: Opens the syntax specific setting file based on the syntax of the active view. This is deprecated and only kept for backwards compatibility.

open_folder.doc_string: Opens the specified folder(s) in the OS file manager.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: The list of absolute path(s) to the directorie(s) to be opened.

open_in_browser.doc_string: Opens the specified html file in the default browser using the file:// protocol.

open_project_or_workspace.doc_string: Opens the specified project or workspace file, in a new window by default.

args.name: file
args.doc_string: The absolute path to the project or workspace file.

args.name: new_window
args.doc_string: Whether to open the specified project or workspace file in a new window.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index of recent folder to be opened as per the folder_history in the session file.

open_recent_project_or_workspace.doc_string: Opens a recently opened project or workspace.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index of the workspace as per recent_workspaces in the session file.

open_symbol_definition.doc_string: Opens the symbol defined in a file. Used internally by the auto_complete_goto_definition command.

args.name: path
args.doc_string: The absolute path to the file where the symbol is defined.

args.name: new_tab
args.doc_string: Whether to open the file (containing the symbol) in a new tab. The default value is 'False'.

args.name: hide_popup
args.doc_string: Whether to hide the popup after navigating to the symbol. The default value is 'False'.

args.name: keep_auto_complete_open
args.doc_string: Whether to preserve the state of the AC window when the view loses focus. The default value is 'False'.

args.name: add_jump_point
args.doc_string: Whether to add the symbol navigation to the jump history list. The default value is -1, indicating that the navigation is not added.

open_url.doc_string: Opens the web browser to display the URL or the default application associated with the file/folder represented by the URL.

args.name: url
args.doc_string: The URL to be opened.

overwrite.doc_string: Overwrites the selection(s) at the caret(s) location(s) with the given characters.

args.name: characters
args.doc_string: The characters that will overwrite the selection(s).

paste.doc_string: Pastes the text on the clipboard at the text selection location(s), replacing the selected text.

paste_and_indent.doc_string: Pastes the text on the clipboard at the text selection location(s), replacing the selected text, and making the base indentation level match that of the target location(s).

paste_from_history.doc_string: Opens a custom context menu, showing a maximum of 15 strings copied to clipboard, from which any one can be selected to be pasted at caret location(s).

prev_bookmark.doc_string: Navigates to the previous bookmark in the document.

prev_field.doc_string: Navigates to the previous field in the snippet.

prev_misspelling.doc_string: Navigates to the previous misspelling in the document.

prev_modification.doc_string: Navigates to the previous modification in the document.

prev_os_tab.doc_string: Sets the focus to the previous window in the os tab.

prev_result.doc_string: Jumps to the previous build result.

prev_view.doc_string: Sets the focus to the previous view by index.

args.name: extend
args.doc_string: Whether to add the previous view to the current group's multiselected sheet(s).

prev_view_in_stack.doc_string: Sets the focus to the previous view in the stack of recent edited view.

primary_j_changed.doc_string: Shows a dialog stating about the change of keybindings for the join_lines command.

profile_plugins.doc_string: Generates a report on the time taken by each plugin to respond to an event.

profile_syntax_definition.doc_string: Runs the syntax performance tests on the given view.

prompt_add_folder.doc_string: Shows the OS native open dialog, so the user can choose what folder they want to add to the sidebar.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_open.doc_string: Shows the MacOS native open dialog, so that the user can choose what file they want to open.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_open_file.doc_string: Shows the OS native open dialog, so that the user can choose what file they want to open.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_open_folder.doc_string: Shows the OS native open dialog, so that the user can choose what folder they want to open.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_open_project_or_workspace.doc_string: Show the OS' native open dialog, so the user can choose what project they want to open.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_save_as.doc_string: Show the OS native save as dialog, so the user can choose the path where they want the file to be saved.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

prompt_select_workspace.doc_string: Opens the Quick Switch Project window.

prompt_switch_project_or_workspace.doc_string: Show the OS native open dialog, so the user can choose what project they want to switch to.

args.name: initial_directory
args.doc_string: An absolute folder path on disk, where the native dialog will initially open.

purchase_license.doc_string: Navigates to the url https://www.sublimehq.com/store/text in the default browser to allow a user to purchase a license..

quick_panel.doc_string: Takes a list of objects with the given keys, caption, command & args. Selecting an option will execute that command with the given arguments.

args.name: items
args.doc_string: The list of objects.

redo_or_repeat.doc_string: Redos the last undo or repeats the last action if there is no undo to revert.

refresh_folder_list.doc_string: Refreshs the folder list in the sidebar from the filesystem.

reindent.doc_string: Reindents the line(s) at cursor location(s).

remove_folder.doc_string: Removes the given directorie(s) from the sidebar.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: The list of directorie(s) to be removed.

remove_license.doc_string: Removes the license. This will cause Sublime Text/Merge to go into an unregistered state.

rename_file.doc_string: Renames the file on disk. Uses a TextInputHandler if the 'new_name' argument is not provided.

args.name: new_name
args.doc_string: The new name for the file.

rename_path.doc_string: Renames the given file(s) on disk.

args.name: paths
args.doc_string: A list of absolute file paths to be renamed.

reopen.doc_string: Reopens the file with a given encoding.

args.name: encoding
args.doc_string: The encoding to be used when the file is reopened.

reopen_last_file.doc_string: Reopens the most recently closed file.

replace_all.doc_string: Replaces all tokens in the view, which matches the pattern in the Find input field.

replace_completion_with_auto_complete.doc_string: Replaces the most recently inserted completion with the next result provided by the auto completion engine.

replace_next.doc_string: Replaces the next token in the view, which matches the pattern in the Find input field.

reset_font_size.doc_string: Resets the font size to the default value.

resize_window.doc_string: Resizes the window's external bounds to the specified width and height.

args.name: width
args.doc_string: The external width of the window.

args.name: height
args.doc_string: The external height of the window.

reveal_in_side_bar.doc_string: Reveals the active view's file in the sidebar.

reveal_link_source.doc_string: Resolves a symlink to expand the folder it represents.

args.name: dirs
args.doc_string: The list of symlink directorie(s) to be resolved.

right_delete.doc_string: Deletes the character to the right of the text selection caret(s).

rot13.doc_string: Uses the Rot13 algorithm to encode the given selection at caret location(s).

run_macro_file.doc_string: Runs a macro saved in a macro file.

args.name: file
args.doc_string: The 'Packages/' relative path to the '.sublime-macro' file.

run_syntax_tests.doc_string: Runs all the syntax test(s) associated with a given '.sublime-syntax' or '.tmLanguage' file or a single syntax test file if the active view's file name starts with 'syntax_test'

args.name: find_all
args.doc_string: Whether to run the syntax test for all files that begin with 'syntax_test'. The default value is 'False', indicating that the syntax test is run only for the active 'syntax_test' file.

args.name: async
args.doc_string: Whether to save the file asynchronously.

args.name: encoding
args.doc_string: The encoding, to save the file as.

args.name: quiet
args.doc_string: Whether to suppress dialogs if the file save fails or requires elevated permissions on the host OS.

save_all.doc_string: Save all the open documents in the active window.

save_macro.doc_string: Save the recorded macro to a file.

save_project_and_workspace_as.doc_string: Opens the OS dialog window to save the active project.

save_workspace_as.doc_string: Opens the OS dialog window to save the active workspace.

scroll_lines.doc_string: Scroll the active view by the specified number of lines. A negative number means to scroll in an upwards direction.

args.name: amount
args.doc_string: The specified amount by which the view has to be scrolled.

scroll_to_bof.doc_string: Scrolls the file to show the beginning of the file.

scroll_to_eof.doc_string: Scrolls the file to show the end of the file.

select_all.doc_string: Selects the entire contents of the document.

select_all_bookmarks.doc_string: Select(s) all the bookmark(s) in the current document.

select_bookmark.doc_string: Select a specific bookmark (by index) in the current document.

select_by_index.doc_string: Focus a view in the active group based on its index.

args.name: index
args.doc_string: The index of the view to focus. The first view will have an index of 0 and so on.

select_color_scheme.doc_string: Sets the color scheme. If the arguments are not provided, opens a ListInputHandler for the user to choose.

args.name: name
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the color scheme. If the value is 'auto', then a light and a dark variant needs to be specified.

args.name: light
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the color scheme that would be applied for OS light mode.

args.name: dark
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the color scheme that would be applied for OS dark mode.

select_lines.doc_string: Adds a new selection (cursor) to the line above or below.

args.name: forward
args.doc_string: Whether to add the new selection (cursor) below the line.

select_theme.doc_string: Sets the theme. If the arguments are not provided, opens a ListInputHandler for the user to choose.

args.name: name
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the theme. If the value is 'auto', then a light and a dark variant needs to be specified.

args.name: light
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the theme that would be applied for OS light mode.

args.name: dark
args.doc_string: The package specific path of the theme that would be applied for OS dark mode.

select_to_left.doc_string: Adds the sheet to the left of the active one to the active groups multiselected sheets.

select_to_right.doc_string: Adds the sheet to the right of the active one to the active groups multiselected sheets.

set_build_system.doc_string: Sets the given build system based on the build file.

args.name: file
args.doc_string: Accepts a 'Packages/' relative path to a sublime build file to set as the current build system. An empty string will set it to the 'Automatic' option as seen in 'Tools -> Build System'.

set_encoding.doc_string: Sets the encoding of the currently open view/document.

args.name: encoding
args.doc_string: The encoding to be set.

set_file_type.doc_string: Sets the syntax for the active view.

args.name: syntax
args.doc_string: The syntax to be set for the active view. Can either be a package relative path like 'Packages/Foo/Bar.sublime-syntax' or 'scope:' prefixed syntax name.

set_layout.doc_string: Sets the layout of the current window based on the structure specified in the args.

set_line_ending.doc_string: Sets the line endings for the files.

args.name: type
args.doc_string: The platform type. Valid values are 'windows', 'unix' & 'cr'.

set_max_columns.doc_string: Readjusts the current layout to have atmost, the specified columns.

args.name: columns
args.doc_string: The number of columns to restrict the layout to.

args.name: setting
args.doc_string: The name of the setting to be modified.

args.name: value
args.doc_string: The value of the setting.

show_at_center.doc_string: Scrolls the file to show the middle of the active viewport.

show_license_window.doc_string: Displays the license dialog. This will only work if you are running an unregistered copy of Sublime Text.

show_overlay.doc_string: Shows the overlay from the argument.

args.name: overlay
args.doc_string: The name of the overlay. Valid values are 'goto' & 'command_palette'.

args.name: text
args.doc_string: The initial text to put in the input widget of the overlay when it is invoked.

args.name: show_files
args.doc_string: Whether to show files in the overlay. Only makes sense when 'name' is set to 'goto'.

args.name: command
args.doc_string: The name of the command. Only makes sense when 'overlay' is set to 'command_palette'

args.name: args
args.doc_string: Arguments to be passed on to the command, if any.

show_panel.doc_string: Shows the panel from the argument.

args.name: panel
args.doc_string: The name of the panel. Valid built in values are 'find', 'incremental_find', 'find_in_files', 'replace', 'console'. Any API created panels can also be opened.

args.name: toggle
args.doc_string: Whether to toggle the visibility of said panel.

args.name: reverse
args.doc_string: Whether to search the buffer for a given find text in a backwards manner.

args.name: regex
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Regular Expression' option.

args.name: case_sensitive
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Case sensitive' option.

args.name: whole_word
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Whole word' option.

args.name: wrap
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Wrap' option.

args.name: in_selection
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'In selection' option.

args.name: highlight
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Highlight matches' option.

args.name: preserve_case
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Preserve Case' option.

args.name: show_context
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Show Context' option.

args.name: use_buffer
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Use Buffer' option.

args.name: use_gitignore
args.doc_string: Whether to activate the 'Use gitignore' option.

args.name: where
args.doc_string: The text to be populated in the 'Where' field of 'Find in Files' panel. Only makes sense when the 'panel' equals 'find_in_files'.

args.name: pattern
args.doc_string: The text to be populated in the 'Find' field.

args.name: replace_pattern
args.doc_string: The text to be populated in the 'Replace' field.

show_scope_name.doc_string: Shows the scope name(s) at the given cursor location, additionally giving the user the ability to copy the scope names.

slurp_find_string.doc_string: Uses the current selection as the find string.

slurp_replace_string.doc_string: Uses the current selection as the replacement string.

soft_redo.doc_string: Redos the last move or action, which has been undone.

soft_undo.doc_string: Undos the last move or action.

sort_selection.doc_string: Sorts the selection(s) in the current buffer.

args.name: case_sensitive
args.doc_string: Whether to do a case sensitive sort.

args.name: remove_duplicates
args.doc_string: Whether to remove any duplicates while sorting.

split_selection_into_lines.doc_string: Splits each selection into individual lines.

sublime_merge_blame_file.doc_string: Git blame selected file(s) with Sublime Merge.

sublime_merge_file_history.doc_string: Show the history of the selected file(s) in Sublime Merge.

sublime_merge_folder_history.doc_string: Show the history of the selected folder(s) in Sublime Merge.

sublime_merge_line_history.doc_string: Shows the history of the selected line(s) in Sublime Merge.

sublime_merge_open_repo.doc_string: Open the repository of the selected file/folder in Sublime Merge.

swap_case.doc_string: Convert uppercase characters to lowercase and vice versa.

swap_line_down.doc_string: Moves each caret(s) line down by one.

swap_line_up.doc_string: Moves each caret(s) line up by one.

switch_file.doc_string: Switches between files having the same name and the specified extensions, additionally opening the file if it's not already open.

args.name: extensions
args.doc_string: The list of allowed extensions.

args.name: side_by_side
args.doc_string: Whether to add the file to the group's multiselected sheets while switching.

syntax_definition_compatability.doc_string: Checks to see the syntax compatability of the currently active .sublime-syntax file. Any incompatible regex patterns (which doesn't conform to sregex) is shown in an output panel.

title_case.doc_string: Converts the selection at caret location(s) to title case.

toggle_bookmark.doc_string: Toggles the bookmarked state for each selection.

toggle_case_sensitive.doc_string: Toggles the 'Case sensitive' flag in the Find/Replace/Incremental Find/Find in Files panel.

toggle_comment.doc_string: Toggles the comment for the particular scope based on the metadata file.

args.name: block
args.doc_string: Whether the comment to be toggled should be a block comment.

args.name: variant
args.doc_string: The line/block comment variant to pick from the preferences file. As an example, 'TM_COMMENT_START_2' - variant of 2, 'TM_COMMENT_START_3' - variant of 3 and so on.

toggle_full_screen.doc_string: Toggles whether the current Sublime Text window is in full screen mode.

toggle_highlight.doc_string: Toggles the 'Highlight matches' flag in the Find/Replace/Incremental Find panel.

toggle_in_selection.doc_string: Toggles the 'In selection' flag in the Find/Replace/Incremental Find panel.

toggle_inline_diff.doc_string: Toggles whether the inline diff of the modifications under the cursor location(s) is displayed.

args.name: prefer_hide
args.doc_string: Whether to hide the other visible diffs, while showing the ones under the cursor location(s).

toggle_menu.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the menu bar.

toggle_minimap.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the minimap.

toggle_overwrite.doc_string: Toggles whether the caret is in insert mode or overwrite mode.

toggle_preserve_case.doc_string: Toggles the 'Preserve case' flag in the Replace panel.

toggle_record_macro.doc_string: Start or stop to record a macro.

toggle_regex.doc_string: Toggles the 'Regular expression' flag in the Find/Replace/Incremental Find/Find in Files panel.

toggle_save_all_on_build.doc_string: Enables/Disables saving all open files before running a build command.

args.name: setting
args.doc_string: The boolean setting to toggle.

toggle_show_context.doc_string: Toggles the 'Show Context' flag in the Find in Files panel.

toggle_show_open_files.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the list of open files in the sidebar.

toggle_side_bar.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the side bar.

toggle_status_bar.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the status bar.

toggle_tabs.doc_string: Toggles the visibility of the tabs.

toggle_use_buffer.doc_string: Toggles the 'Use Buffer' flag in the Find in Files panel.

toggle_use_gitignore.doc_string: Toggles the 'Use gitignore' flag in the Find in Files panel.

toggle_whole_word.doc_string: Toggles the 'Whole word' flag in the Find/Replace/Incremental Find/Find in Files panel.

toggle_wrap.doc_string: Toggles the 'Wrap' flag in Find/Replace/Incremental Find panel.

trim_trailing_white_space.doc_string: Deletes trailing whitespace from all lines.

unfold.doc_string: Unfolds all folded region(s) at the given caret location(s).

unfold_all.doc_string: Unfolds all folded region(s) in the given buffer.

unindent.doc_string: Unindents the selection at caret location(s) by one level.

unselect_others.doc_string: Deselects all of the multi selected tabs.

unselect_to_left.doc_string: Deselects all of the multi selected tabs to the left of the currently focussed tab.

unselect_to_right.doc_string: Deselects all of the multi selected tabs to the right of the currently focussed tab.

update_check.doc_string: Opens the update dialog box of Sublime Text.

upgrade_license.doc_string: Navigates to https://www.sublimehq.com/store/upgrade, where you can upgrade an expired license.

upper_case.doc_string: Converts the given selection at caret location(s) to upper case.

view_resource.doc_string: Shows the given resource file in a read only mode (unless the respective package name is present in 'Packages/'). If the resource path is not given via 'name', a ListInputHandler is shown to allow the user to pick a resource file.

args.name: name
args.doc_string: The path to the resource file, relative to the package name.

wrap_lines.doc_string: Hard wraps all lines at the ruler.

args.name: width
args.doc_string: The column at which the lines should be hard wraped.
